summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine daily share repurchases under its buy-back programme announced 7 May 2026. On 15 and 16 July 2026, Shell purchased 3.075 million and 3.147 million shares, respectively, across LSE, Chi-X, and BATS, at average prices around GBP 31.62 and GBP 31.50, for cancellation. Goldman Sachs International executes trades independently within parameters, complying with UK/EU MAR. The buy-back reduces share count, returning capital to shareholders. No specific premium or terms beyond daily purchases. Watch for continuation of programme and cumulative capital return impact.
